Name: Junimo Livestock
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS
THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE

In theme with my pet junimo and junimo horse mods, I have made all the farm animals into junimos. Each one uniquely color based on their original animal. Baby variants also included with unique appearance to set them from the adults.

[b][u]Install info
[/u][/b]Unzip the file, copy and paste into Content/Animals folder.  If you don't like the look of one just remove it from my file before pasting.

[b][u]Install info Content Patcher pack only

[/u][/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
